recs.x:
"so there’s no natural ‘deinterlacing’ effect that blends the screens together."

The natural deinterlacing effect happens in viewers brain, not on the Screen. You got this entirely backwards. The whole reason interlaced picture doesnt work on LCD is because previous frame stays on the screen. I highly recommend "How a TV Works in Slow Motion - The Slow Mo Guys" [link]
